source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.7
text: Seed rice production runs through a sequence of field stages — nursery/seedbed (សំណាប), transplanting (ការស្ទូង), tillering (ចេញកួរ), heading/panicle emergence (ទុំ), and harvest (ច្រូតកាត់) — culminating in a finished seed product (ស្រូវពូជ) as distinct from ordinary consumption paddy (ស្រូវចំណី). At each of these production stages the field must pass a corresponding official field inspection (អធិការកិច្ចតាមស្រែ) before the crop is allowed to proceed to the next stage or ultimately be certified as seed; a field that fails an inspection (ធ្លាក់) does not continue in the seed program and its output is downgraded to ordinary paddy (ស្រូវចំណី), while a field that passes (ជាប់) continues toward becoming certified seed (ស្រូវពូជ).
